summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate (RIT) with embedded software experience across STM32 Cortex-M4, Arduino, and NVIDIA Jetson platforms. Proficient in bare-metal C, FreeRTOS multi-threaded task coordination, and hardware-level protocols (UART, I2C, SPI); experienced writing time-critical software for real-time hardware testing and control systems.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Led a 25-member robotics team across national-level competitions, owning PCB fabrication and embedded software integration end-to-end.
Designed custom single-layer PCBs in EAGLE for locomotive robots; implemented sensor communication over UART and I2C with closed-loop feedback.
Organized 10+ technical workshops covering Arduino, embedded C, and PCB design.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture-recognition glove integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth; translated 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands via Python.
Implemented a custom tap-detection algorithm using z-axis differential thresholding; resolved sensor jitter through software calibration and resolution tuning.

projects.name: STM32 Bare-Metal Temperature Monitor
bullets: Programmed all peripherals in bare-metal C (GPIO, TIM2, ADC1, I2C1) on Cortex-M4; achieved 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM at a deterministic 1 Hz update rate, verified in Proteus.
Implemented timer-triggered ADC scan conversions, interrupt-driven sample capture, and a low-level I2C driver — time-critical firmware with no OS dependency.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Used FreeRTOS with mutexes for multi-threaded task coordination on STM32; integrated VL53L0X ToF over I2C and drove multi-servo PWM with interrupt-driven UART command parsing from Jetson.
Deployed YOLOv8 on NVIDIA Jetson for hardware-in-the-loop object detection; closed-loop servo tracking over UART with real-time user override.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Delivery Drone
bullets: Built Arduino flight controller in C++: PWM throttle mapping to 4x 30A SimonK ESCs, Bluetooth command parser with ESC arming sequence, and per-motor override.
Deployed a Linux systemd service on Jetson Orin Nano with SIGTERM/SIGINT signal handling, WebSocket auto-reconnect, and serial passthrough to hardware (Restart=always).

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Integrated dual VL53L0X ToF sensors via TCA9548A I2C mux for range-gating and gripper contact detection (25 mm trigger); two-link IK on Arduino in C++ driving five servos.
100% pick reliability (10/10 trials); TensorRT-optimized YOLO: 5.2× speedup (56.7→10.9 ms, 17.6→92 FPS).

awards: 1st Prize, Poster Presentation — 2D and 3D Image Mosaicing of Microscopic Images, F.C.R.I.T. (2024)
1st Prize, CanSat Workshop — Arduino Nano atmospheric data collection during free fall (2023)
